description: The chart illustrates differences in “% point difference” across several model configuration categories, shown as paired bars for each category. The category axis is horizontal and contains configuration labels that include “hidden:[1], linear,” “hidden:[100], ReLU,” and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” (with additional labels partially visible), presented in a left-to-right order as printed; the value axis is vertical, labeled “% point difference,” and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at approximately −0.1, 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2, spanning at least from about −0.1 up to around 0.25. Each category displays two adjacent bars (a lighter blue bar and a darker blue bar) of similar width, indicating a grouped arrangement; approximate bar heights include a leftmost light-blue bar extending down to about −0.1 with a neighboring dark-blue bar slightly above 0 (around 0.03–0.05), a mid-chart pair where the light-blue bar is around 0.12 and the dark-blue bar reaches roughly 0.24–0.25, another pair with a light-blue bar near 0.10 and a dark-blue bar near 0.15, and a rightmost visible pair where the light-blue bar is around 0.12 and the dark-blue bar is around 0.18–0.20. No legend is visible in the cropped view, and there are no apparent annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the consistent use of two blue shades for the grouped bars.
